rows.vgi.doc_llm: The classifier's entire ImageNet-1k label set as a queryable table of `(idx, label)` rows — all 1000 classes the model can predict — so it reads like a normal table you query without parentheses, unlike the parenthesized `image_classes()` table function it scans. Use it to discover or validate which labels `top_label`/`classify` can return, or to join predicted labels against the canonical class list. `idx` is the 0-based position into the model's output vector; `label` is the human-readable class name. Always returns exactly 1000 rows.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## `image_classes` (table)

A scan-backed table listing **every ImageNet-1k class** the model can predict (1000 rows), queried without parentheses (`vision.main.image_classes`) — the same data the `image_classes()` table function returns.

### Columns

| column | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `idx` | INTEGER | 0-based class index into the model output |
| `label` | VARCHAR | ImageNet class label |

### Notes

Useful to validate or join against predicted labels from `top_label` / `classify`.
